name: Elsa Guzman
life: “I still remember a visiting schedule with a whole blank week.” Monday often includes a stop at the public end of the South Shore boardwalk, where Elsa checks the shade on the benches before deciding how long to stay.
voice: I never have visitors. I booked the plant for Thursday and three gardeners turned up.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a rust-colored canvas coat and a tiny red thread tied through the lowest buttonhole. Elsa has a heart-shaped face and prominent ears, with silvery hair gathered at the nape. Elsa touches a knuckle to the chin when searching for a word during a conversation.
personality: Elsa is fond of ambitious ideas and deeply suspicious of grand openings. The question Elsa asks at any launch is who has the keys for cleaning up a month later.
agenda: To invite the three gardeners back next Thursday.
family: Victor Anders is Elsa’s younger cousin. Elsa gets to change the plan. Victor offers the first invitation. They learned that a promise to visit is easier to keep when changing a time does not count as letting down the whole family. Asked about *The tide clock*, Victor says, “I arrived at the dentist six hours early and left with a vacancy on his cleaning crew.”
connections: Karina Hamilton. A rooted cutting is small enough to visit a patient who lacks ordinary callers.

reactions.response: Elsa checks the visiting list for the patients who will miss their turn.
